text:
sara: FYI GreenPeak's VRM sent back the SIG. They want question-by-question evidence and a mapping file. Deadline = EOD Friday. Who owns what?

mike: I can take infra controls, network segmentation, and auth diagrams.

ana: I'm ana (security). I'll own crypto/KMS, logging, monitoring, and IR. Will need the latest key rotation proof and KMS policy.

sara: @ana awesome. @mike can you capture KV for autoscaling and batching behaviour? Customer specifically asked about prefix caching and how we isolate tenant caches.

mike: Yep. Quick note: for caching/kv we typically provide an architecture diagram + runtime config snippet. I'll prepare: `arch/cache-isolation.png` + `redwood-runtime.conf` excerpt.

elena: I can coordinate upload with GreenPeak. Do they want evidence per-question or a single bundle?

sara: Per-question preferred (VRM said they ingest into their GRC tool). Please also include a CSV mapping: question_id -> artifact_path -> short note.

ana: Understood. For KMS evidence I'll include: key policy JSON, rotation logs (redacted), and attestations. Where should I drop those?

mike: Use the shared artifacts bucket: `s3://redwood-sig-artifacts/greenpeak/` with folder structure `/section/question-id/`. Example: `s3://redwood-sig-artifacts/greenpeak/cryptography/3.2/`. Pre-signed links are fine for them to pull.

elena: I'll request their preferred ingest method. Can we provide pre-signed links expiring 7 days?

ana: Yes. Security note: scrub any user-level PII from logs before uploading. I'll run the redaction script.

mike: Putting together a small export command for infra docs, posting below:
```
# export infra & logging artifacts
redwoodctl export-sig --customer greenpeak \\
  --sections infra,logging,auth,crypto \\
  --format s3 --output s3://redwood-sig-artifacts/greenpeak/export-2025-03-22/
```

sara: @tom any legal items they flagged in the SIG? Data residency / subprocessors?

tom: They flagged residency — want proof data never left EU region for their EU tenants. Also asked for list of subprocessors and subcontractor SOC2 / ISO certs. We should include dated cert PDFs and our subprocessor list.

mike: I have the subprocessor list in the console export. Will include `subprocessors.csv`.

ana: For residency, we can provide audit/tracing logs showing region tags + controls for routing. Note: logs contain IPs, so I'll sanitize before upload.

evidence-bot: artifact uploaded: s3://redwood-sig-artifacts/greenpeak/mapping/greenpeak-sig-mapping-20250322.csv (:package:)

elena: Received, thanks bot. I'll package the presigned links into a single email to their VRM once we finish.

sara: Plan for next 48h: 1) owners prepare artifacts (mike/ana) 2) elena coordinates with customer for ingest format 3) tom ensures legal docs attached. I'll do a final pass on the mapping CSV. Ping here when each artifact is ready.

mike: Will post infra & auth artifacts by tomorrow 10:00 PT.

ana: Crypto & logging artifacts by tomorrow 16:00 PT (need to run redaction).

tom: I'll attach DPA excerpt and subprocessor proofs by EOD tomorrow.

elena: I'll confirm ingest method with GreenPeak now and post back.

sara: Thanks team :thumbsup: — GreenPeak is a POC-candidate, let's move fast.

mike: one last thing — GreenPeak asked whether we can provide a short walkthrough call once they review artifacts. Can we plan ~30m after upload?

ana: I can attend. mike?

mike: Yep, count me in.

sara: Great. I'll propose times after upload.

elena: Update: VRM prefers Tuesday morning CET. I'll tentatively request 09:00 CET.

sara: Cool. Marking this thread as owner-of-record for the SIG artifacts.

mike: uploading now...

evidence-bot: artifact uploaded: s3://redwood-sig-artifacts/greenpeak/infra/1.1/arch-diagram.png

ana: uploaded redacted rotation logs to `s3://redwood-sig-artifacts/greenpeak/cryptography/3.2/rotation-logs-redacted.log`

sara: perfect. keep notes here if any blocker appears.

elena: VRM confirmed Tuesday 09:00 CET for walkthrough. I'll send calendar invite once uploads complete.

tom: flagged a legal question for the call re: data export model (we may need to prep a short statement).

sara: noted. Thanks all.
